en.title: US-Iran Diplomatic Meeting Uncertainty Grows
en.summary: The probability of a US-Iran diplomatic meeting by June 30, 2026, has risen to 36% due to stalled talks and escalating tensions. Recent statements from Trump and the US's cold response to Iran's proposals have intensified concerns.
drivers: Stalled talks amid rising energy costs
Trump's aggressive rhetoric on Iran
US rejection of Iran's non-nuclear deal proposal
en.why_matters: The outcome of US-Iran relations impacts regional stability and global energy markets, making this a critical issue.
en.bull_case: If diplomatic efforts resume positively, the probability of a meeting could significantly increase.
en.bear_case: Continued hostility and lack of compromise may lead to a complete breakdown in talks.

zh.title: 美伊外交会议不确定性加剧

drivers: 因能源成本上升而停滞的谈判
特朗普对伊朗的强硬言辞

zh.why_matters: 美伊关系的结果影响地区稳定和全球能源市场，使其成为关键问题。
zh.bull_case: 如果外交努力积极恢复，会议的概率可能显著增加。
